clips.title: The story
paras: Deep in the murkiest reaches of the Quagmire lies Tabetha's Farm, an isolated homestead centered around a small wooden hut, a modest garden, and a private dock. Despite the treacherous marsh surroundings, this sanctuary serves as a hidden redoubt for the hermit mage Tabetha.

Tucked away in the western wetlands of Dustwallow Marsh, Tabetha's Farm defies its unforgiving environment. Consisting of a weather-worn hut, small vegetable plots, and a dock for navigating the swamp's murky waterways, the homestead offers a quiet refuge far from the political rivalries of Theramore and Brackenwall Village. Here, the reclusive human sorceress Tabetha lives in near-total seclusion, pursuing esoteric studies of arcane and fel power without interference from Dalaran or local authorities.

Despite its remote location, the farm attracts practitioners of the magical arts from across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms. Mages seeking mastery over raw arcane surges and warlocks seeking aid to cleanse volatile artifacts like the Orb of Orahil are directed to Tabetha's doorstep.
